    },

      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements an order-preserving integer and varint serialization primitive used for the index keys.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a novel order-preserving varint serialization format to shared serialization infrastructure. While valuable for building sorted indices, it serves as secondary plumbing for the new indexing feature."
